items.text: to dig a way along the cottage (doer: the woman)
items.evidence: 8039_1-3, 0.12-7.88s: she shovels a trench that runs from the camera back past the front/left corner of the cottage toward the open field; the cottage wall with the window is behind the right snow wall, facing the camera. The path is not seen running along the cottage wall.

items.text: to squeeze past the shovel (doer: the dog)
items.evidence: Text identical to round 1 (ok); confirmed by quick look. R1: 1.62-2.88s the husky drops into the narrow path and squeezes between the left snow wall and the shovel (handle across in front of it at 2.12-2.38s, blade beside it at 2.62-2.88s); P2 box follows it.

items.text: to cheer from inside the cottage (doer: the man)
items.evidence: Behind the window the man raises a fist and cheers 1.12-2.62s and 4.62-5.12s; P3 box on him.

Zoomed still: the point is on a thin strip of path floor visible between her legs and the shovel handle, only ~0.03 from the shovel point (0.40,0.70) - labels overlap on the nouns sheet and a tap there reads as legs/shovel.
